explanation.headline: FDA's records trace this shortage to a plant on our own labels

sentences.text: FDA inspection 683318 of Baxter Healthcare Corporation (FEI 2650090) ended on 2010-09-30 and was classified OAI with a known date of 2010-12-29.
The Baxter plant was later inspected and classified VAI on 2015-02-06, 2018-10-24, and most recently on 2025-03-26.
A second registered plant for sevoflurane, Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407), received an OAI classification on 2009-06-11 and a Warning Letter on 2010-04-08.
Bryant Ranch Prepack has since received VAI classifications through the most recent inspection ending 2026-07-16.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Decision on cisplatin: transfer cisplatin between Corvale hospitals weekly instead of buying grey-market stock. Rationale: Grey-market offers were 6 to 10 times contract price with unverifiable pedigree (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.

Q-ead109.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%sevoflurane%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%sevoflurane%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-30b0f2.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('22700993-851a-48aa-941e-1d2b6b04081f', '06b9f724-6425-4976-93eb-b9ca343ef5cf') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-5f3a44.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%sevoflurane%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-d506ca.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%sevoflurane%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-cae6d4.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%sevoflurane%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%liquid%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-fefaa1.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('1000519407', '2650090') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-e8ffe3.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('1000519407', '2650090') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-340b00.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('1000519407', '2650090') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('bryant ranch prepack', 'baxter')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-14cce6.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('bryant ranch prepack', 'baxter') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%sevoflurane%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-212b70.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('590126', '683318') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-975d0b.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('10019065706', '72162224502')
